newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Congress approves 1997 federal budget.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Congress approves 1997 federal budget.

text.p: Brazil's Congress approved the federal government's 431-billion reais budget for 1997 late on Wednesday, an official said.

A joint session of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate approved the budget drawn up by the Planning Ministry and was due to vote later on a single amendment to provide more funding for a hospital in Brasilia, the official said.
Of the total budget, 208 billion reais were earmarked for debt rollover and retirement, about 17 billion reais for investment and the remainder for payrolls and other costs.

The budget was approved last week at committee-level when the government defeated a motion which would have forced it to meet the spending items included in the bill even if it failed to raise the necessary receipts.
The budget must now be sanctioned by President Fernando Henrique Cardoso who has single-line veto powers over its contents. --William Schomberg, Brasilia newsroom 5561 2230358
